concepts.name: MetaReasoning
concepts.description: Thinking about thinking; reasoning about one's own knowledge, reasoning, and learning.

concepts.name: Problem
concepts.description: A situation the agent is trying to solve or explain.

concepts.name: Issue
concepts.description: A detected difficulty in solving the problem, such as an error or a gap.

concepts.name: IssueType
concepts.description: The classification of an issue as an Error or a Gap.

concepts.name: Error
concepts.description: A case where existing knowledge, reasoning, or learning is incorrect.

concepts.name: KnowledgeError
concepts.description: An error caused by incorrect or inconsistent knowledge.

concepts.name: ReasoningError
concepts.description: An error caused by a faulty inference or reasoning step.

concepts.name: LearningError
concepts.description: An error caused by an incorrect learned explanation or concept.

concepts.name: Gap
concepts.description: A missing piece of knowledge or reasoning that prevents progress on the problem.

concepts.name: KnowledgeGap
concepts.description: Missing knowledge that links two parts of an explanation.

concepts.name: ReasoningGap
concepts.description: A missing inference step that would connect known facts.

concepts.name: MetaGoal
concepts.description: A goal at the meta-level to fix an error or fill a gap.

concepts.name: RepairGoal
concepts.description: A meta-goal to repair incorrect knowledge or reasoning.

concepts.name: AcquireGoal
concepts.description: A meta-goal to acquire missing knowledge or construct missing links.

concepts.name: Strategy
concepts.description: A method or procedure for reasoning about a problem or meta-goal.

concepts.name: CaseBasedReasoning
concepts.description: Solving new problems by retrieving and adapting past cases.

concepts.name: MeansEndsAnalysis
concepts.description: Reducing the difference between current and goal states by selecting operators.

concepts.name: ProblemReduction
concepts.description: Decomposing a complex goal into simpler, more independent subgoals.

concepts.name: ConstraintPropagation
concepts.description: Using constraints to restrict the space of possible solutions.

concepts.name: GenerateAndTest
concepts.description: Generating candidate solutions and testing them with a heuristic or evaluation function.

concepts.name: StrategySelection
concepts.description: The process of choosing which strategy to use for a given meta-goal.

concepts.name: StrategyIntegration
concepts.description: The process of switching between or combining multiple strategies during problem solving.

concepts.name: StrategyCriteria
concepts.description: Criteria used to select a strategy, such as knowledge requirements, computational efficiency, and solution quality.

concepts.name: Status
concepts.description: The progress state of a strategy, such as Progress or Stall.

concepts.name: Resolution
concepts.description: The final result produced by meta-reasoning: repaired knowledge, new knowledge, or a successful plan.

concepts.name: Cases
concepts.description: Stored prior problems and solutions used by case-based reasoning.

concepts.name: Constraints
concepts.description: Relations or restrictions among variables used by constraint propagation.

concepts.name: MR
concepts.description: Abbreviation for MetaReasoning

relations.name: hasIssueType
relations.description: Relates an Issue to its IssueType (Error or Gap).

relations.name: hasErrorIn
relations.description: Relates an Error to the component it occurs in (knowledge, reasoning, or learning).

relations.name: spawns
relations.description: Relates an Issue or Gap to the MetaGoal it generates.

relations.name: requiresKnowledge
relations.description: Relates a Strategy to the knowledge structures it needs.

relations.name: applicableTo
relations.description: Relates a Strategy to the kind of MetaGoal it can address.

relations.name: integratesWith
relations.description: Relates a Strategy to another Strategy that can be combined with it.

relations.name: improves
relations.description: Relates a Strategy or MetaGoal to the Resolution it helps to produce.

relations.name: usesStrategy
relations.description: Relates MetaReasoning or MetaGoal to the Strategy chosen.
